 Order

10.01.2025 Heard Shri M. Pathak, learned counsel for the petitioners, who have filed this petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Surakshya Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS in short) for quashing of the FIR registered as Mukalmua P.S. Case No. 255/2024, u/s 406/420/435/506/34 of IPC.
Let notice be issued, returnable on 12.10.2025.
Public Prosecutor, Assam accepts notice on behalf of the State respondent no.1.
Let steps be taken for service of notice upon the respondent no.2 by registered post with A/D.
Shri Pathak, the learned counsel for the petitioner prays for an interim order.
He has submitted that earlier vide an order dated 02.12.2024, the petitioners have been granted anticipatory bail by this Court.

He has also Page No.# 3/3 submitted that the dispute is absolutely of civil nature regarding to dissolution of a partnership and the present case has been lodged only for the purpose of giving harassment.

Considering the above, it is directed that till the next returnable dated, no coercive action be taken against the petitioner in connection with Mukalmua P.S. Case No. 255/2024, u/s 406/420/435/506/34 of IPC.
